proposedArchitecture.choice: Upstream-first source tree with cohesive Pulse-owned modules and a small explicit integration patch set.
alternatives: Direct edits throughout upstream: simpler initially, more recurring conflict sites.
Separate companion process/application: stronger source isolation, but duplicates lifecycle/auth/state and complicates cross-client integration.
rules: Preserve upstream file paths and ownership.
Prefer modules inside existing packages; create new packages only for real dependency or reuse needs.
Sequence shared contracts and runtime integration before independent UI work.
Extract a seam only to remove recurring conflicts or isolate important behavior for tests.
Track every upstream integration edit and its compatibility test.
Do not promise zero upstream edits or automatic forward compatibility.
